brief: Newsletter from 0 to 50,000 subscribers with AI. The compounding playbook, the topic shifts, the monetization at scale.

slots.title: Stop guessing.
slots.description: Build a 50,000-subscriber newsletter using AI. The compounding playbook that turns content into a growth engine.

slots.title: Pick topics
slots.description: Most newsletters fail because they chase trends. AI finds underserved niches with high intent.
slots.badText: You guess topics based on gut feeling and get ignored.
slots.goodText: AI analyzes search intent and surfaces high-contraction ideas.

slots.title: Write faster
slots.description: Speed up creation without losing your voice. AI drafts, you refine.
slots.badText: You stare at a blank page for hours and publish late.
slots.goodText: AI generates structured drafts from a single prompt.

slots.title: Compound
slots.description: Each send builds on the last. AI repurposes content into evergreen assets.
slots.badText: Every issue dies after one send with zero reuse.
slots.goodText: One issue becomes threads, carousels, and lead magnets.

slots.title: Shift topics
slots.description: Pivot your angle as you grow. AI tracks what resonates and maps the transition.
slots.badText: You pivot blindly and lose half your list overnight.
slots.goodText: AI segments readers and tests new angles before full shifts.

slots.title: Monetize
slots.description: Turn attention into revenue. AI identifies sponsors and automates outreach.
slots.badText: You cold-pitch brands manually with no tracking.
slots.goodText: AI scores leads and writes personalized sponsor sequences.

slots.title: Automate
slots.description: Remove yourself from the daily grind. AI runs research, writing, and scheduling.
slots.badText: You are the bottleneck. Growth stalls when you take a break.
slots.goodText: Systems run the newsletter while you focus on strategy.

slots.body: Join 10,000+ creators using AI to build newsletters that compound. Get the full playbook free.
